scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir app" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test:e2e: cd backend && uv run python -m tests.e2e_flow
scripts.reset: cd backend && uv run python -m tools.reset --yes
scripts.seed:samples: cd backend && uv run python -m tools.seed_final_samples
scripts.test:final: cd backend && uv run python -m tests.final_live_flow
scripts.migrate:vectors: cd backend && uv run python -m tools.migrate_vectors
